Dashboard summary - default (today, Asia/Jakarta)
item.description:
Report membaca langsung dari fakta domain (tanpa tabel projection / listener event):
sales.cash.*    ← payment: applied_amount (uang masuk ke tagihan, SEMUA kanal: CASH/QRIS/XENDIT)
sales.billing.* ← invoice: settled_amount saat lunas, piutang berjalan (snapshot, bukan periode)
topMenus        ← baris invoice dari invoice yang lunas (sejalan dengan settledAmount)
operations      ← dining & order
recentActivity  ← 10 order terbaru LINTAS PERIODE + billingStatus dari invoice yang memuat order
Satu-satunya jalur uang adalah POST /payments (B2 ditutup) — kas & billing bergerak dari jalur yang sama.
Parameter: from & to opsional (YYYY-MM-DD, default hari ini WIB), inklusif.
Validasi: to < from -> 400; from di masa depan -> 400; to di masa depan boleh.
Format waktu: semua timestamp = LocalDateTime tanpa offset, wall clock Asia/Jakarta (WIB).
FE harus parse sebagai '+07:00' (new Date(value + '+07:00')), bukan new Date(value).

item.name: Dashboard summary - month to date (hanya 'from'; 'to' default = hari ini)
Dashboard summary - only 'to' ('from' default = hari ini; 200 walau to di masa depan)
Dashboard summary - range tanpa data (200, angka 0 dan array kosong)
Dashboard summary - invalid ('to' before 'from') (400: "'to' date must not be before 'from' date")
Dashboard summary - invalid ('from' in the future) (400: "'from' date must not be in the future")
Dashboard summary - invalid ('from' not a date) (400)
Dashboard summary - forbidden (403: akun tanpa report.read, mis. WAITER/KITCHEN)
Webhook - PAID (marks payment as paid)
item.description:
Simulates Xendit invoice callbacks. No Bearer token — auth is via X-Callback-Token.
Handler: POST /api/v1/payments/webhooks/xendit (payment-xendit module)
The external_id must match an existing PENDING payment — copy the real value from the
create payment response. status=PAID marks the payment as paid, applies the amount to the
invoice, and is read live by the dashboard (sales.cash / sales.billing / topMenus).
